entries.note: Independent audit of all 11 relay.chart keys against en source + context (maxCells via rich cell_len, all within budget), glossary and locale style guide: meaning, tooltip/button idiom, placeholder parity, NFC/no Cf controls, register, data_toggle byte-identical to the native app's audited mobile.session.inline_chart_data (local-operator-mobile origin/main), role read as an aria-roledescription noun. Translator and auditor ran on the same model id (no fallback observed); they are separate agent sessions; the auditor edited no catalogue. RTL: Urdu comma in position, ASCII colon kept in axis_value/also, parentheses mirror. Accepted MINORs (not applied): total 'کل' is a homograph of relay.notifications.section.yesterday 'کل' (kal); the tooltip row beside a number disambiguates it, 'کل میزان' would be unambiguous. also 'مزید:' reads 'more:' and repeats the word used by `more`; 'نیز: {items}' or 'اس کے علاوہ: {items}' is closer to 'Also:'. position rephrased ('نمبر {index}، کل {count}') keeps placeholder order and reads naturally aloud.
